title: glechoma pusilla
intro: Glechoma pusilla, commonly known as Creeping Speedwell, is a perennial herbaceous plant that belongs to the mint family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can aid in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Glechoma pusilla are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
